bagPolicy.summary: Bags must not exceed 11 × 14 inches and are searched; clear bags are not required. The theatre may change the rule for an event.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The Hollywood Park complex has multiple parking zones, and the theatre recommends buying parking before the event and arriving early.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The theatre publishes a dedicated rideshare pickup and drop-off page; consult its event map for the designated area.

concessions.summary: Drinks and snacks are sold at East and West bars on the Orchestra, Plaza and Balcony levels; food trucks operate outside. One factory-sealed 20 oz water bottle or an empty refillable plastic bottle is allowed.
allowed: One factory-sealed water bottle up to 20 oz
